scope.surface: Publish repository provider step, popup anatomy, provider readiness, backdrop dismissal, and runtime readiness

productLoss: The valid pre-fix Browser state showed the Lynx popup sections arranged horizontally: the 630.828125px header, 355.265625px body, and 220px footer overflowed the 576px dialog.
Lynx relied on unsupported flex wrapping, producing one vertical provider column at x=1061.09375 instead of Web's 526x110 two-column provider grid.
The Lynx steps measured variable widths and 58px height instead of Web's three 170x49 cards, and the popup measured 576x302 instead of 576x364.
Lynx rendered provider host subtitles that are absent from the Web provider-step authority and relied on a first-child selector that Native did not apply.
harnessLoss: The first Browser attempt reached a transient dual-dialog state before discoverSourceControl completed, then lost the dialog before capture.

The report originally read data-git-publish-dialog from the fullscreen Lynx overlay while Web attached it to the popup. Measurement now selects the Web dialog popup or the Lynx git-publish-dialog leaf.
Dismissal overwrote the pre-dismiss structural evidence. The harness now freezes the matched dialog anatomy before real backdrop taps.
The harness now waits for real readVcsStatus and discoverSourceControl command results before admission and allows one bounded discovery-complete reopen.

Outer Page.captureScreenshot retains the same dialog-crop bytes before and after and OCR finds no dialog copy, even after two iframe requestAnimationFrame commits. Those PNGs are stale iframe compositor frames and are rejected rather than used as product material evidence.
intentionalPlatformDelta: Web title and description boxes span 526px while Lynx text leaves span 494px because the Lynx close control reserves explicit heading space. Their font size, weight, line height, origin, and visible copy match; this width-only leaf allocation does not change popup geometry.
classification.evidenceBoundary: Browser before and after use one immutable database, selected thread, route, theme, viewport, Web bundle, provider readiness set, real trigger taps, real backdrop taps, zero-error console, and clean leak gates. DOM geometry, styles, copy, and behavior are retained. Exact-bundle Native independently proves the final geometry, authenticated provider, sequence advance, dismissal, zero renderer errors, and cleanup. Browser and Native material pixels remain unknown.
